description: S51 T2 (TM1), the narrow edit: title and body and NOTHING else — validation state, priority, duplicate_of, roadmap_item_id, filed_by and every timestamp but updated_at are outside the statement itself. A nil field means LEAVE ALONE (absent on the wire, not empty: an empty title is a refusal, not a rename). The actor comes from the connection and the store writes the 'update' audit row beside the edit in one transaction, its summary naming the FIELD WORDS (SEC-033: no user text rides the audit). changed:false is legal and earns no row; a param carrying actor/actorKind/filedBy is refused by key before any of this.
